tasks.label: 1 · Verify ReceiptSnap install
tasks.command: cd ~/receiptsnap-mobile && npm run test:unit && npx tsc --noEmit && echo '=== ALL GOOD — proceed to task 2 ==='

tasks.label: 3 · EAS — create project + enable OTA updates
tasks.command: cd ~/receiptsnap-mobile && npx eas-cli@latest init && npx eas-cli@latest update:configure

tasks.label: 5 · EAS — BUILD iOS dev client (the one build)
tasks.command: cd ~/receiptsnap-mobile && npx eas-cli@latest build --profile development --platform ios
